turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay.
Mm-hm isn't an answer. Who decided on the zero?
Is that all I get? Who decided, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Are you finished? Because I stopped listening about five minutes ago.
I'm not finished. You stopped listening, and my son still has a zero. Who decided on it, or I go to the principal's office.
